evidence.title: New, first-of-its-kind international high school basketball league announced

occurrences.quote_span: The six international teams included are Mega Basket (Serbia), OrangeAcademy (Ulm, Germany), Orange1 (Bassano, Italy), Orangeville Prep (Ontario, Canada), Pallacanestro (Varese, Italy) and Žalgiris, (Lithuania).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

- 12 games with all teams competing

occurrences.checkable_against: ATLAS team roster and league announcement
occurrences.quote_span: This new league features 11 of the best teams from all over the globe with four different countries being represented.

occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

occurrences.checkable_against: ATLAS launch release quoting Kevin Boyle
occurrences.quote_span: "Through world-class competition, coaching, and exposure to different styles of play and cultures, we are preparing the next generation for high-level college basketball, the NBA, and Europe's premier professional leagues."
occurrences.speaker: SPIRE head coach Kevin Boyle
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

occurrences.quote_span:

- 4 games with Spire, DME Academy, Geneva, Sunrise Christian, IMG Academy, Orangeville Prep competing
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

occurrences.quote_span: The list of American teams includes DME Academy (FL), IMG Academy (FL), Prolific Prep (FL), SPIRE (OH) and Sunrise Christian (KS).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

occurrences.quote_span:
December 6 (Miami, FL)
- 2 games with Sunrise Christian, DME Academy, Spire and Prolific Prep competing
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

occurrences.quote_span: As for the regular season, it tips off at IMG with games being played from November 11-13.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

occurrences.checkable_against: ATLAS launch release quoting Kevin Boyle
occurrences.quote_span: "Atlas is building what I believe is the first truly elite international youth basketball league, bringing together top programs from North America and Europe," SPIRE said head coach Kevin Boyle included in the release.
occurrences.speaker: SPIRE head coach Kevin Boyle
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league

occurrences.checkable_against: WorldStage Sports ATLAS launch announcement or release
occurrences.quote_span: On Thursday, Oct. 8, it was announced that WorldStage Sports has launched ATLAS, a new international league that will feature the world's best high school and academy basketball teams.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: WorldStage Sports' ATLAS basketball league
